Superior Standard Features

Premium materials and on-site workmanship are central to every Appalachian Farmhouse.

Pressure-Treated Foundation4×6 pressure-treated beams supported on 16×16×4-inch solid concrete pads, with an engineered layout based on building size and loads.
Strong Floor System2×6 pressure-treated joists at 16″ on center and ¾″ pressure-treated exterior-rated plywood decking.
Precisely Framed Walls2×4 kiln-dried studs at 16″ on center.
Classic 8/12 RoofEngineered traditional roof framing, ½″ CDX plywood sheathing, architectural shingles, and appropriate underlayment.
Roof VentilationRidge vent ventilation for the traditional roof assembly.
Craftsman DetailsCedar trim and fascia, weather-sealed openings, and distinctive farmhouse-style architectural details.

Good to know

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Appalachian Farmhouse built on my property?

Yes. All Appalachian Sheds buildings are constructed on site. Each building is constructed on site by our crew.

Does the listed price include a finished interior?

No. The standard product is an exterior weather-tight shell. Interior insulation, finish materials, electrical work, and other interior improvements are separate options when offered and specified.

When does the exterior need to be painted or stained?

Required exterior caulking/sealing and painting or staining must be completed within 30 days of construction, as appropriate for the specified siding and trim. We also offer an optional complete exterior painting service.

What if my property needs additional leveling?

Standard foundation leveling covers up to 6 inches of out-of-level conditions. Additional leveling or site preparation is quoted in writing.

Can I select a size not featured in the quick comparison?

Yes. The complete pricing schedule includes 21 sizes. We can also review larger or specialized dimensions in a written proposal.

Does the listed price account for my property's requirements?

Your written proposal confirms the final building configuration and addresses site access, support and anchorage requirements, requested options, and other applicable project costs.
